tracks.name: Neon Megacity Grandway
tracks.blurb: Skyline straights, a harbour hairpin and the tunnel under Tower Row.

tracks.name: Solar Rift Canyon
tracks.blurb: Long canyon arcs that climb 40 m to the Rift Crest and dive back to the floor.

tracks.name: Prism Glacier Run
tracks.blurb: Technical switchbacks across the ice shelf. Brake early, carry the drift.

tracks.name: Quantum Void Spiral
tracks.blurb: A figure-eight in deep space. The Void Bridge crosses 12 m above the lower loop.

tracks.name: Verdant Ion Causeway
tracks.blurb: Flat-out causeways and flowing esses through the bioluminescent wetlands.

tracks.name: Nova Foundry Circuit
tracks.blurb: Industrial chicanes, the furnace tunnel and a rival pack that never lifts.
